description: kitr new --kit dashboard: A logged-in app on an external API: http, forms, tables, state, theme, tailwind, auth, mocks, testing.

kitr.name: dashboard
kitr.title: Dashboard kit
kitr.summary: Start a logged-in app on an external API: forms, tables, state, theme, auth, mocks and tests.

kit.audience: Teams building an admin or internal tool on an API they already run.

highlights.title: Talks to your API
highlights.text: `http` is pointed at `VITE_API_URL`, with typed requests and errors.

highlights.title: Sign-in with tokens
highlights.text: `auth` keeps the session and guards pages; `app/abilities.ts` holds the permissions.

highlights.title: Build before the API exists
highlights.text: Set `VITE_MOCKS=true` and the handlers in `app/mocks/` answer every request.

highlights.title: Eleven components to own
highlights.text: Button, form, data table, app shell and more, copied into `app/components/ui`.

run: Vitest, starting with the home page test
